_note: Maintainer RIAEvangelist added malicious code directly into package source (geoIP-gated file wiper targeting Russian/Belarusian IPs), shipped via a new transitive dependency (peacenotwar module) that ran at runtime from index.js, not via a lifecycle install script. This is a KNOWN GAP: DepWall has no 'malicious runtime payload in package source' detector. The real attack shape — mature package, real registry entry, no install scripts — evades every current signal (no exfil-script pattern, no slopsquat/name mismatch, no provenance drop since npm attestations didn't exist as an ecosystem norm before 2023). Honest limitations: install-time gating is blind to package-source malice; detected only at import time. This fixture documents the detection gap, not a signal bug, consistent with the project's pattern of documenting uncontested limitations.
